rumdl.bash: if command -v rumdl >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec rumdl server; elif command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec uvx rumdl server; elif command -v bunx >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bunx rumdl server; else exec npx --yes rumdl server; fi
rumdl.powershell: if (Get-Command rumdl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { rumdl server } elseif (Get-Command uvx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { uvx rumdl server } elseif (Get-Command bunx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { bunx rumdl server } else { npx --yes rumdl server }
